known_cutoff_publicity_caveats: This one-entry registry is restricted to non-evaluation acquisition disclosure review and is not an evaluated benchmark model registry.

Google documents gemini-3.5-flash as a stable model ID rather than a latest or preview alias, but says stable IDs usually do not change and does not guarantee immutable weights or expose a dated snapshot.
Every official response must return the exact modelVersion gemini-3.5-flash or fail closed.
Raw marker-page prompts, provider output, and supporting excerpts remain private; only hash-bound decisions and run summaries may be public.
